about: Blind-test outcomes of the two submissions. Both scored zero hits.

submissions.name: Submission 1: two-anchor ErG union
submissions.method: single-anchor pharmacophore similarity (ErG), top 40 compounds from one anchor and top 10 from another

submissions.name: Submission 2: three-channel rank fusion
submissions.method: reciprocal rank fusion of Boltz-2 co-folding affinity, a water-mediated pharmacophore and a DEL classifier, greedy per-series diversity selection
